messages:
cs-amber: :rotating_light: Customer ACME reporting spike of 503s and timeouts when streaming large responses. First seen ~09:10 UTC. They say requests hang for ~10-15s then return 503. They attached client logs.

oncall-bot: Noted. Opening incident channel and paginating oncall. Runbook: collect runner logs, docker events, and dmesg.

ryan: I'm looking. Can you paste the top-level log lines from the infer-runner? esp around container restart.

cs-amber: here's snip from customer trace and our gateway:

```
2026-03-16T09:09:59Z gateway: upstream 10.2.18.5:8080 error: read tcp 10.1.2.3:54321->10.2.18.5:8080: connection reset by peer
infer-runner: fatal: SIGSEGV at 0x7ff... frame=...
kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 12345 (python) total-vm:6148914688kB, anon-rss:8000000kB
```

sophie: hmm kernel OOM then segfaults. Which image tag? we recently rolled q8-nn-runtime:v2.6.4.

mike: that rollout included the new prefetch tuning for kv cache. We saw increased host mem usage in staging but not kills. Could this be memory leak when streaming long prompts + large kvcache?

devon: recreating locally with the customer's repro (long chat stream ~12k tokens) now. steps:
```
export REPRO_PROMPT=@customer_sample.txt
./scripts/run_local_infer.sh --model redwood-3b --stream --context 12000
```

ryan: If it's OOM on host, immediate mitigation: rollback runtime to v2.6.3 on affected pool, enable fallback routing to smaller model, and add a temporary per-request token limit on hosted.

sophie: I'll queue rollback on pool eu-west-1-pool-3 and open a capacity burst on spare machines. Also enabling autoscaler to favour nodes with bigger host memory.

oncall-bot: Action items logged: #INC-7590001 (rollback queued), #INC-7590002 (customer mitigation). ETA 15m.

mike: For root cause we need full heap profiles. If we can repro, capture pmap + python tracemalloc and nvprof? Also grab nvml logs: `nvidia-smi dmon` during repro.

cs-amber: Customer applied our suggestion (lowered request size) and saw immediate recovery. They're asking for ETA and root cause.

ryan: tell CS: short-term: rollback + token cap rolled out to affected customers (15m). Long-term: collect heap + nvml traces, add canary for q8-nn-runtime builds, and add preflight memory checks in prefetch path.

sophie: created follow-up ticket ENG-7590 for memory regression test + preflight. Will assign to mike.

mike: capturing repro artifacts now. If anyone else has similar reports, ping here.

cs-amber: customer satisfied for now, requesting postmortem and timeline. :thumbsup:

ryan: will assemble postmortem draft after we have heap profiles. closing incident channel when ENG-7590 lands.
